texts.3530fe5f18101f9275df70a23ea2454f0b36f4b3:
:- use_module(library(pita)).
:- pita.
:- begin_lpad.
:- table on/2.
on(0,1):1/3 ; on(0,2):1/3 ; on(0,3):1/3.
on(X,1):1/3 ; on(X,2):1/3 ; on(X,3):1/3 :- X1 is X-1, X1 >= 0, on(X1,_), \+ on(X1,3).
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = on(100,1), prob(Q, P)), format("~q:\t~w~n", [Q, P])).

on(X,1):1/3 ; on(X,2):1/3 ; on(X,3):1/3 :- X1 is X-1, X1 >= 0, on(X1,_), \+ on(X1,3).
:- end_lpad.
main :-
    forall((Q = on(10,1), prob(Q, P)), format("~q:\t~w~n", [Q, P])).
